title: Solid Core vs. Cellular Core PVC in Drainage Systems
description: Understanding pipe material properties is essential for long-lasting drainage installations. Both Solid Core PVC and Cellular Core (Foam Core) PVC are widely used in DWV (Drain, Waste, and Vent) systems, but they carry distinct physical characteristics. Solid Core features a homogenous PVC structure throughout the pipe wall, offering higher structural stiffness and impact resistance. Cellular core pipe contains an expanded foam inner layer sandwiched between solid PVC skins, making it lighter and cost-effective. However, cellular core is limited to non-pressure gravity DWV systems. Always check local code approvals prior to installation.
